title: Getting started
text: Getting started Download Scooby and sign in with your existing account. In the game selector, open Source Games → Half-Life 1 . All four games share the Half-Life 1 dashboard and this guide. Use Game version to choose Half-Life 1, Half-Life: Blue Shift, Half-Life: Opposing Force or Half-Life: Source. Match the installed edition. Enable Start game if you want Load to launch your selected Steam title. A game that is already running will be detected. Use OpenGL for Half-Life 1, Opposing Force and Blue Shift; Half-Life: Source uses Windows x86 with Direct3D 9. Select Load . Scooby downloads and verifies the files for your chosen edition, then waits for the matching game. All four editions have free access. Use F2 , Insert or your saved menu key to open the menu. Use Open Scooby folder to prepare and open the files for the selected edition. Use the wiki navigation for setup and feature details.

Download or runtime error Check your network connection, disk space and folder permissions. Install both x64 and x86 VC++ runtimes. Retry Load to re-check hashes and replace missing runtime assets. title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting The loader says Part I is not running Make sure the game itself has opened, not just Steam or a launcher. The loader detects tlou-i.exe . Wait for startup to finish and check the selected edition is Part I. The menu does not appear Wait for a rendered game scene and press F1 or Insert. If an older DLL is already loaded, close the game normally, reopen it and load the current version. Do not repeatedly load different builds into the same process. A download could not be verified Retry after checking the connection. If the release is being updated, wait for the DLL and matching manifests to finish publishing. The loader rejects a mismatched or incomplete module. ESP, weapon or self controls are unavailable Load a save and enter gameplay. Some features require a loaded player, camera, weapon or nearby entities. Read the disabled control’s explanation. title: DLCs (Vehicles and Peds)
text: DLCs (Vehicles and Peds) Scooby can browse vehicles and peds (character models) from GTA 5 title updates. A downloaded vehicle preset, outfit, and custom DLC pack are different kinds of content. Start by checking what the download contains. Identify your download DLC vehicles DLC peds Troubleshooting What are you trying to install? A saved vehicle: a compatible .json , .xml , or .ini preset belongs in the saved-vehicle library. Follow Modded Vehicles . A saved outfit: a native .json or supported .xml clothing preset belongs in Saved Outfits. Follow Outfits . A custom vehicle or ped model: a download containing dlc.rpf , .yft , .ydd , or .ytd is a model/asset package. The outfit and vehicle preset folders do not install these game assets. Custom DLC packs There is no verified drop-in DLC-pack installation workflow for Scooby in this guide. Use the pack author's installation instructions for your exact GTA 5 edition and required loader. Copying an RPF into C:\scooby\GTA5\vehicles , or renaming it to JSON, will not install it. A preset can only use a model that the game can already load. Find and spawn a built-in DLC vehicle Open Scooby's Vehicle menu, then Open Vehicle Spawner . Use the DLC filter to select a title update, or choose All to search across releases. Use Class and the name search to narrow the list. Clear these filters if a vehicle seems to be missing. Select an available vehicle to spawn it. If you customize it and want a reusable file, follow the vehicle saving steps . Built-in DLC models come from your installed game files; you do not need to download a shared vehicle save just to browse them. Choose a DLC ped or character model Open Self → Outfit Editor → Model Changer . Search by name and choose a Category and DLC . Set the DLC filter to All to widen the results. Select a model to apply it. Save your current outfit first if you want to return to its clothing later. Use an outfit made for the selected model. Clothing components and props can differ between male and female freemode characters and other peds. If a model is missing or will not load Nothing in the list: clear the search, category/class, and DLC filters. A favorites-only view can also hide models. Model unavailable: check that it exists in your installed GTA 5 edition and build. A name in a catalog or shared preset does not add the model to your game. Custom pack does not appear: check the pack author's edition requirements and installation steps. Refreshing Saved Vehicles only rescans presets. Wrong clothing after changing ped: switch to the model the outfit was created for, then load the outfit again.

title: How To Host Public Sessions with Scooby (BE Disabled)
text: How To Host Public Sessions with Scooby (BE Disabled) Getting a public lobby to fill up is not just luck - it comes down to a handful of factors you can actually control. This guide covers what makes players join your session and what to do when nobody shows up. Premium: you must remain the session host This hosting guide is for Premium with BattlEye disabled . Premium lets you host public lobbies and play with friends, but you must remain the session host at all times to avoid being desynced after about 3–5 minutes as a non-host. Premium Plus supports BattlEye enabled and lets you play as either the host or a non-host. The free version does not support public lobbies. Compare Free, Premium, and Premium Plus online access → For the Premium hosting steps below, launch GTA 5 with BattlEye disabled in the Rockstar Launcher settings. Premium Plus users playing with BattlEye enabled do not need to follow this host-only setup. There are four factors behind a lobby that actually fills: your NAT type, your aim type, the region and time you host in, and a fair amount of luck. 1. NAT Type Your NAT type affects how easily other players can connect to your lobby. Open NAT - best results for hosting Moderate NAT - usually works fine Strict NAT - may reduce player joins and connectivity Important things to know: NAT type is normally controlled by your router and your ISP , not by the game. Some tools and scripts offer NAT spoofing, which presents a different NAT type to GTA Online. Results vary a lot and it does not work the same for every player. If you consistently struggle to attract players, check your NAT type and confirm your ISP is not putting you behind CGNAT (see below). 2. Aim Type Your aim setting decides which pool of players can even match with you. Free Aim - largest player pool on PC, attracts the most players Partial Aim Assist - still a decent number of players Full Aim Assist - smallest player pool on PC, expect fewer joins For the highest chance of filling a lobby, start with Free Aim . 3. Region and Timing Timing matters as much as the region itself. Aim for hours when people are: Getting home from work Finishing school Already gaming during the evening Good windows to try: North America, evenings Europe, evenings Weekends beat weekday mornings by a wide margin If one region is quiet, switch to another and try again. 4. Luck Sometimes everything is set up perfectly and the lobby still will not fill. You can host a session that fills instantly, then host the exact same session 30 minutes later and get nobody. GTA Online matchmaking is unpredictable, so persistence is part of the process. Bonus: Check for CGNAT Some ISPs place customers behind Carrier Grade NAT (CGNAT) , which shares one public IP between many customers. This can hurt your connectivity, your matchmaking and your hosting reliability. Contact your ISP Ask whether your connection is behind CGNAT Request a public IPv4 address if they offer one Bonus: Use a VPN A VPN can sometimes improve how visible you are in matchmaking. Best practice: Connect to a VPN server in a densely populated area Match your VPN region to the audience you are trying to attract Locations players commonly report good results with: New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, London, Frankfurt . Results vary, but busy metro areas generally give better lobby population. Checklist - you have done everything right if: You have Premium and remain the session host Session advertising is enabled You are on Open or Moderate NAT You picked the right Aim Type (Free Aim fills fastest) You chose an active region and a busy time of day You confirmed you are not behind CGNAT Still Alone? Be patient. Try different combinations, restart the session, switch regions and keep experimenting. An empty lobby after one attempt does not mean your setup is wrong. If All Else Fails - Get Friends to Join First A lobby that already has a few players inside attracts far more players than an empty one. Once the first few people arrive, GTA Online matchmaking tends to do the rest. You can also turn on Player Magnet in the Network tab to help pull players in. In short: hosting is a combination of NAT type, aim type, region, ISP quality and a little bit of luck .

title: Getting Luas
text: Getting Luas Lua scripts add tools and custom interfaces to Scooby. Choose a script written for Scooby GTA 5, or a port that explicitly supports your menu version and GTA 5 edition. You can find shared scripts in the Scooby community or get them directly from their author. Lua folder and menu C:\scooby\GTA5\lua Settings → Lua Editor → Scripts Older builds may label the screen Lua Scripts . Install Run and stop Other-menu scripts Troubleshooting Install a downloaded script Download the script and extract it if it is inside a ZIP or other archive. Check the author's requirements and keep any supplied libraries, configuration, and assets. Open Settings → Lua Editor and select Open Lua Folder . You can also paste C:\scooby\GTA5\lua into File Explorer's address bar. For a standalone script, copy its .lua file directly into that folder. For a package, follow the author's folder layout so its supporting files stay in the expected locations. Open the Scripts tab and select Refresh Scripts . Select the script file in the library. Select Run / Reload . Check the running-script list and the Console tab for its status or any startup error. C:\scooby\GTA5\lua\ MyScript.lua Keep the real .lua extension. A file named MyScript.lua.txt or a downloaded web page will not load as a Lua script. Enable file-name extensions in File Explorer if you cannot see the ending. Reload, stop, and enable auto-run Run / Reload: starts the selected script, or reloads it after an edit. Reload / Stop: use the controls beside a running script. Stop All Scripts stops the entire running list. Auto-run: tick the checkbox beside a script in the library to run it when the menu starts. Test it manually first. Untick it to disable automatic startup. Remove a script: stop it, disable its auto-run checkbox, then remove its file from the Lua folder and refresh. Keep any settings you want to back up. A script may add its own menu or window. Look at its instructions if it is running but you cannot find its controls. Scripts made for another menu Sharing the .lua extension does not guarantee compatibility. Scooby has compatibility helpers, but a script that relies on another menu's API may still need changes. Prefer a Scooby version supplied by the author. Some builds expose Lua Scripts → Other Menus Luas for compatible imports from C:\scooby\GTA5\lua\other-menus-luas . If that screen is available, keep the package structure, refresh its list, and use Load . The current Lua Editor interface uses the Scripts tab described above; do not look for a separate tab if your build does not show one. For creating or porting a script, open the Scooby GTA 5 Lua API reference . If a script does not work Missing from Scripts: check the folder, extract the archive, confirm the .lua extension, clear the search, and refresh. Start with a standalone script directly in the Lua folder. Missing module or asset: restore the full package and follow its original directory layout. Error immediately after running: read the first error in Console . Confirm Scooby support and the correct Legacy/Enhanced edition with the author. Problems on every startup: untick auto-run and stop the script. If you cannot reach the menu, close the game and move that script out of the Lua folder before starting again.

title: Outfits
text: Outfits Saved Outfits lets you keep clothing components, textures, and props in portable files. Use a preset made for the same ped or freemode character model as your character. Outfit folder and menu C:\scooby\GTA5\outfits Self → Outfit Editor → Saved Outfits in ClickUI and ListUI. Native saves use .json ; supported .xml outfits can also be loaded. Install Other-menu imports Save and share Troubleshooting Install and wear a shared outfit Download the outfit from its author or the Scooby community . Extract the download if it is an archive. Open Saved Outfits and use Open Folder / Open in Explorer , or paste C:\scooby\GTA5\outfits into File Explorer. Copy the compatible .json or .xml outfit into that folder. You can organize native saves in your own subfolders. Return to Saved Outfits , select Refresh , and open the folder containing the file. Select the outfit to apply it. If clothing looks wrong, switch to the character model it was made for and load it again. C:\scooby\GTA5\outfits\ MyOutfit.json Favorites\ AnotherOutfit.xml Import an outfit from another menu Keep the original export format and place it in the matching import folder: Stand: C:\scooby\GTA5\other-menu-addons\stand-outfits Cherax: C:\scooby\GTA5\other-menu-addons\cherax-outfits Other supported exports: C:\scooby\GTA5\other-menu-addons\other-menus-outfits Open the Other Menu / Other Menus outfit library, refresh, then select the import. Compatible .json , .txt , .ini , and .xml exports can be scanned; the file's internal structure must also be supported. Keep imports directly in the matching folder to make them easy to find. For the format notes included with your installation, read C:\scooby\GTA5\other-menu-addons\OUTFITS-GUIDE.txt . Create, save, and share your own outfit Use Outfit Editor to choose the clothing components, textures, and props you want. Open Saved Outfits . Browse to your destination or select New Folder . Select Save Current Outfit and enter a filename without an extension. Scooby adds .json automatically. Use Open Folder to find the saved file. Copy it to a backup or share it together with the character model it was created for. Wardrobe Manager manages GTA's in-game wardrobe slots. Use Saved Outfits when you want a portable file. If an outfit is missing or looks wrong Missing file: check its extension and folder, open the correct subfolder, and refresh. Other-menu exports may need the import library instead. Refuses to load: restore the original file or ask for a supported export. Renaming a file extension does not convert it. Wrong clothing: component and prop indexes differ by model. Use the same ped and male/female freemode model as the original outfit. Downloaded model assets: .ydd , .ytd , and RPF packs are not outfit presets. See DLCs (Vehicles and Peds) . Back up the outfits folder and any import folders while Scooby is closed. In ListUI, pressing Right on a local saved outfit deletes its file permanently.

title: Themes
text: Themes Scooby themes can include colors, layout settings, backgrounds, and other image layers. A theme may be a single JSON file or a folder containing its settings and images. Theme folder and menu C:\scooby\GTA5\themes Settings → Appearance → Themes Use Open Themes Folder to open the correct location. Install Apply Save and share Troubleshooting Install a downloaded theme Get a Scooby GTA 5 theme from its author or the Scooby community . Extract the archive first. Open Settings → Appearance → Themes → Open Themes Folder . For a single-file theme, copy the .json file directly into C:\scooby\GTA5\themes . For a theme bundle, copy the entire theme folder into themes . Keep its JSON and image files together, with the author's filenames and relative paths unchanged. Return to the menu and select Refresh Library . Example layouts (the image filenames in your download may be different): C:\scooby\GTA5\themes\ SimpleTheme.json MyTheme\ MyTheme.json background.png The theme JSON should sit at the top of its bundle folder. Avoid accidentally adding an extra wrapper folder when extracting a ZIP. Apply a theme to the interface you use Select the theme in the library. Choose Save / Load Scope : Both , ClickUI , or ListUI . Select Load Selected Theme . Check the status message and the chosen interface. Both applies the available settings for both interfaces. ClickUI or ListUI applies that interface and its shared appearance settings. The theme must contain settings for the scope you choose; a ClickUI-only theme cannot supply a ListUI design. Save, back up, and share your design Adjust the appearance settings and choose the scope you want to save. Enter a new custom theme name and select Save Current Theme . Scooby creates C:\scooby\GTA5\themes\YourTheme\YourTheme.json and bundles referenced images into the theme folder. Use Open Selected Folder to find the result. Back up or ZIP the entire folder when sharing it. Quick Save updates the selected custom theme. Use a new name when you want to keep the previous version. Built-in themes are protected from overwriting and deletion; save a custom copy to edit them. If the theme does not look right Not listed: extract the archive, check that the JSON is directly in themes or directly inside its bundle folder, clear the search, and refresh. Missing background or images: copy the complete bundle again. Sharing only its JSON can leave referenced images behind. Only one interface changes: check Save / Load Scope and the interfaces included in the theme. Load fails: restore the original JSON and confirm the theme supports your Scooby version. A theme from another menu is not automatically compatible. Want to undo a change: load a previously saved theme or a built-in theme from the library. Save your current design before experimenting if you want to keep it.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting Here are solutions to common issues you may encounter: Failed to allocate memory in target process Head to your Rockstar Launcher, click on Settings, and disable BattlEye . This will fix the issue. Please return to Grand Theft Auto V (Black Screen) You must inject the menu during the loading screen. This message means the game is signifying you're going back to story mode. BattlEye is required to play GTA V Online Same solution - inject the menu during the loading screen, not when you're already in the game. Black screen with an error message Restart your game without opening Scooby and go to story mode before injecting. Frame Generator is now supported , so you no longer need to turn it off. Failed to write process memory Turn off BattlEye in the Rockstar Launcher settings. Launcher, free key & injection troubleshooting Follow this guide if the launcher closes after opening, the free key website is unreachable, injection fails, or injection succeeds but the menu does not work in game. Check your connection. Try a VPN, then retry the website or launcher. Your network or ISP may be blocking the connection. Clear the cache if the launcher still closes or injection fails. Close Scooby, delete the C:\scooby folder, then restart Scooby and try again. If injection still fails, check whether antivirus is blocking the loader. title: Money, items & weapons
text: Money, items & weapons Money, items, weapons, and rewards depend on the server you are playing on. There is no universal trigger that works on every server. Reviewing server events Load into the server and wait for its resources to finish loading. Use the server dump feature, then review the dumped resources for events related to inventories, weapons, jobs, or rewards. Read the surrounding code to understand an event’s purpose and requirements. An event name alone does not tell you whether it will work. Why an event may not work Servers may validate these events on the server side. A request can be rejected if you do not meet the required conditions, such as being in the correct location, having the right job or permissions, or completing a task before claiming its reward. A server dump does not guarantee access to the server-side logic or reveal every validation check. Risk of a kick or ban Attempting to use a protected event may result in an immediate kick or ban, or may have no effect. Finding an event in a dump does not mean it is unprotected or safe to use. Server-specific support You are responsible for finding and understanding events for the server you use. Scooby does not provide server-specific money, item, weapon, or reward triggers, and support cannot help you find working triggers or bypass a server’s protections.

title: Configs & Backups
text: Configs & Backups A config profile captures the menu settings you want to reuse. Use separate named profiles for different setups, and keep a copy of your current profile before trying someone else's. Config folder and menu C:\scooby\RDR2\configs Settings → GUI → Configs Named profiles use the .config extension. Save a profile Install and load Back up content Troubleshooting Save your current settings Set up the menu as you want it, then open Settings → GUI → Configs . Enter a New config name and select Save New . The saved profile becomes the active config. Use Open Folder to find its .config file. To update it later, use Quick Save Active . To overwrite another selected profile, use Save Selected and confirm the overwrite. Choose a simple name such as MySetup . The menu adds the extension. default is reserved and is not a normal named profile. Auto Save Features controls whether feature toggles and values are saved automatically. With it off, feature changes remain live for the session; a manual config save still captures them. Install and load a shared profile Get a compatible Scooby RDR2 .config file and extract it if needed. Open the Configs screen and select Open Folder . Copy the file directly into C:\scooby\RDR2\configs . Keep its extension. Select Refresh , choose the profile in Config Library , then select Load Selected . You can also double-click its row. Check the active profile name and review the loaded feature settings before continuing. C:\scooby\RDR2\configs\ MySetup.config SharedSetup.config A config changes menu settings. It does not copy the author's Lua scripts, outfit files, or image assets to your computer. Install those separately if the setup depends on them. Back up your personal content Close the game and Scooby, then copy the folders you want to preserve to your backup location: C:\scooby\RDR2\configs — settings and named profiles. C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits — player outfits and the Horse subfolder. C:\scooby\RDR2\lua — scripts and their supporting configuration/data. C:\scooby\RDR2\theme — saved appearance JSON files. C:\scooby\RDR2\images — custom images and ListUI image themes. Preserve filenames and folder structure. To restore a file, copy it back to the same location, then refresh the relevant library. Refreshing the Lua library stops running scripts, so start the scripts you need again afterward. If a profile does not save or load Not listed: check the .config extension, place the file directly in the configs folder, and refresh. The internal default.config is intentionally hidden from the named-profile list. Invalid name: use 1–64 characters without Windows filename symbols such as \ / : * ? , and avoid the reserved name default . Incompatible settings: restore the original file or ask for an export from a compatible Scooby RDR2 version. Renaming a GTA config does not convert it. Images or scripts are missing: restore those files separately as well as the config.

title: Horse Outfits
text: Horse Outfits The horse outfit editor works on your active, saddle, or recent horse. Its saves apply equipment to an existing horse, so have the horse you want to customize available before loading a preset. Horse outfit folder and menu C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits\Horse Self → Outfits → Outfits → Horse Choose Editor , Saved Outfits , or Presets inside the Horse tab. This is part of the Premium outfit editor. Choose your horse Install Save and share Troubleshooting Choose and customize your horse Mount or call the horse you want to edit. The editor can keep targeting your saddle or recent horse after you dismount. Open the Horse → Editor tab and select Refresh Horse . Wait for the compatible equipment scan to finish. Adjust the available items and textures, or open Presets to try a built-in horse appearance. Use a matching horse model when possible. Equipment and coat compatibility can differ between models. Loading a saved horse outfit applies its components to the current target; it does not spawn a horse or change that horse into the saved model. Install a shared horse outfit Get a horse outfit exported by Scooby RDR2 and extract the archive if necessary. Paste C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits\Horse into File Explorer. Copy the .json directly into that folder. Open Horse → Saved Outfits and clear the saved-outfit search if needed. Select the file and use Load Selected . If Apply saved horse outfit when clicked is enabled, selecting the row loads it immediately. C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits\Horse\ MyHorseOutfit.json Use the horse editor's own export format. Player outfit JSON files and unrelated legacy horse files are not interchangeable with these saves. Save and share your horse's equipment With the target horse available, open Horse → Saved Outfits . Enter a Horse outfit name , then select Save Current . Alternatively, use Quick Save for an automatically generated name. Back up or share the JSON from outfits\Horse , including the horse model you used. Choose a new name when you want to keep an earlier version. If your horse outfit does not work No horse found: mount or call your horse, then use Refresh Horse . No compatible slots yet: let the equipment scan finish before editing. File is missing: keep it directly in outfits\Horse , confirm the .json extension, clear the search, and reopen Saved Outfits. Unsupported horse outfit format: ask for a save made with the Scooby RDR2 horse editor. Renaming another file does not convert it. Appearance differs: try the same horse model the author used. Built-in legacy presets apply a compatible coat base, while native saves retain individual equipment components.

title: Getting Luas
text: Getting Luas Choose scripts written for Scooby RDR2 . You can find shared scripts in the Scooby community or get them from their author. GTA 5 and RedM scripts may need a port before they work here. Lua folder and menu C:\scooby\RDR2\lua Settings → Lua Scripts → Scripts The workspace heading is Lua Editor . Install Run and stop Create a script Troubleshooting Install and run a downloaded script Download the RDR2 script and extract it if it arrives in an archive. Keep its supporting libraries, configuration, and assets. Open Settings → Lua Scripts and select Open Lua Folder . You can also paste C:\scooby\RDR2\lua into File Explorer. Place the main .lua file directly in that folder. Keep supporting files in the locations specified by the author. Open the Scripts tab and select Refresh Scripts . Select the file in Script Library , then select Run / Reload . Check the Runtime panel for its running status. C:\scooby\RDR2\lua\ MyRDR2Script.lua ScoobyRDR2Template.lua The script list scans .lua files directly inside lua . A main script buried in an extra download folder will not appear. Keep the real extension visible so you do not accidentally install MyRDR2Script.lua.txt . Reload, stop, and refresh scripts Run / Reload: loads the selected script and enables it. Reload: restarts a script from the Runtime panel after changes. Stop: disables that script. Stop All Scripts disables the running list. Refresh Scripts: rescans the folder and stops the currently running scripts. Run the scripts you want again after refreshing. Scripts start disabled when the library is initialized. Run the scripts you need from this screen; the GTA 5 auto-run checkbox is not part of this RDR2 workflow. To remove a script, stop it, remove its main file from the Lua folder, and refresh. Keep any configuration or data files you want to reuse. Start your own script Use New RDR2 Script to create a starter file, or open the bundled ScoobyRDR2Template.lua with Open in Editor . In Code Editor , enable API Documentation to see RDR2 function descriptions and examples. A script may draw its own window or expose its controls in a separate menu. Check the author's instructions if the Runtime panel says it is running but you cannot find its controls. If the script does not work Not in the list: extract the archive, place the main .lua directly in the Lua folder, clear the search, and refresh. Error on startup: read the message in Runtime or the Console tab. Confirm that the script supports Scooby RDR2 and your menu version. Missing module or image: restore the full download and its expected supporting folders. Stopped after adding another script: refreshing the list stops running scripts. Select each one you want and use Run / Reload again.

title: Outfits
text: Outfits Saved Outfits keeps your character's model and equipped clothing in readable JSON files. Use an outfit made for RDR2 and the character or Online gender you intend to use. Outfit folder and menu C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits Self → Outfits → Outfits → Saved Outfits The outfit editor is a Premium feature in this build. Its saved files use .json . Install Wardrobe and presets Save and share Troubleshooting Install and load a shared outfit Download a Scooby RDR2 outfit from its author or the Scooby community . Extract it if it arrives in an archive. Paste C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits into File Explorer and copy the outfit's .json file directly into that folder. Open Self → Outfits , choose the Outfits tab, then open Saved Outfits . Select Refresh and use Clear Search if needed. Select the outfit and use Load Selected Outfit . If Apply outfit when clicked is enabled, selecting it applies it immediately. C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits\ MyOutfit.json Horse\ MyHorseOutfit.json Player outfits go directly in outfits . Files inside outfits\Horse belong to the separate horse outfit editor . A saved player outfit can restore its saved model as well as clothing. Save your current outfit before trying another, and keep Story Mode and Online presets clearly named. Edit your wardrobe or use a preset Open Wardrobe and select Refresh Wardrobe after changing models. Wait for the compatible clothing scan to finish. Adjust the available clothing items and textures in each slot. For a ready-made look, open Presets . Choose the appropriate male/female folder, or use Use Detected Model Folder for your current multiplayer model. Apply a compatible preset, then return to Wardrobe to make any changes. Save and share your own outfit Open Saved Outfits after finishing your clothing changes. Enter an Outfit name and select Save Outfit . Scooby adds the JSON extension. Use Quick Save if you want an automatically generated name. Find the saved file in C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits . Copy it to a backup or share it with the intended character/model details. If an outfit fails to appear or apply Missing file: put the JSON directly in the outfits folder, refresh, and clear the search. Unsupported or broken file: restore the original download or request a Scooby RDR2 export. A GTA outfit, XML file, or renamed file is not automatically compatible. Wrong model or gender: use a preset for the intended character. Some incompatible Online outfits are rejected instead of applied. No clothing slots: refresh the wardrobe and wait for the scan. Some models expose fewer compatible items. Feature locked: check that your RDR2 license includes the Premium outfit editor.

title: Themes
text: Themes RDR2 has two separate theme workflows: saved appearance settings in JSON files, and ListUI image folders. Check what your download contains before choosing its destination. Theme locations Saved appearance JSON: C:\scooby\RDR2\theme ListUI images: C:\scooby\RDR2\images\ListUI Start in Settings → Appearance . JSON themes ListUI images Save and restore Troubleshooting Install a saved JSON theme Get a theme made for Scooby RDR2 and extract the download. Copy its .json file directly into C:\scooby\RDR2\theme . The folder name is theme , without a trailing “s”. Open Settings → Appearance → Themes . In Saved Themes , select Refresh , select the theme from the library, and select Load . C:\scooby\RDR2\theme\ MyTheme.json Keep the JSON directly in the theme folder; this library does not scan theme subfolders. If the theme refers to custom images, keep those files available at the paths specified by the author. Install a ListUI image theme Open Settings → Appearance → ListUI , then the Images controls. Select Open Image Folder , or open C:\scooby\RDR2\images\ListUI in File Explorer. Copy the entire image-theme folder there, preserving its slot filenames. Select Reload Images , then use Next Theme until your theme is selected. Enable the image slots you want, such as Header and Menu Background . Check Image Opacity if they appear invisible. C:\scooby\RDR2\images\ListUI\ MyTheme\ header.png background.png selector.png Supported slot-image extensions are .gif , .png , .jpg , and .jpeg . Slot names matter: preserve names such as header , background , and selector . Loose slot images can also live directly in the ListUI folder. Save your design or restore defaults Adjust the appearance settings, then open Themes → Saved Themes . Enter a new Theme name without the extension and select Save Current . Find the resulting JSON in C:\scooby\RDR2\theme . Use a different name to keep an older design; saving with the same name replaces that file. When sharing, include any separately referenced images or ListUI image folder. The JSON save does not bundle those image files for you. Apply Preset changes the built-in color palette while keeping your layout and images. Restore Scooby Defaults restores ClickUI appearance settings after confirmation without deleting saved theme files. For a broader backup of your menu settings, use a config profile as well as copying the theme and image files. If your theme is missing or incomplete JSON theme not listed: check the singular theme folder, remove any extra archive wrapper folder, and refresh. ListUI images missing: check the selected native theme, slot filenames, image toggles, and opacity, then reload images. Only part of the design changes: load the appearance JSON and select the image theme separately when the author supplies both. Load fails: restore the original JSON and confirm it is for Scooby RDR2. GTA 5 theme bundles use a different workflow.

title: Vehicles, Peds & Animals
text: Vehicles, Peds & Animals RDR2's spawners use models already available in the game. Open a library, search for a model, preview it, and use its spawn action. A ped is a character model; spawning one creates another character, while Model Changer changes your own. Where to find the spawners World → Spawn → Vehicle / Ped / Animal For your own character: Self → Outfits → Model Changer . Vehicles Peds and animals Your character Troubleshooting Spawn a wagon or other vehicle Load into the game and open World → Spawn → Vehicle . Choose All Vehicles and search the Vehicle Library . A favorites-only view will show a smaller list. Select an entry and check its name and model in Selected Vehicle . Use Preview to inspect it, then Spawn Vehicle to create it near your character. Leave enough open space for larger vehicles. This is a model-spawning workflow. The supplied RDR2 build does not provide GTA 5's saved-vehicle JSON/XML/INI import workflow, so copying GTA vehicle presets into a new RDR2 vehicles folder will not install them. Spawn a character or animal Choose World → Spawn → Ped for characters, or World → Spawn → Animal for animals. Select a category, or use All Peds / All Animals . Search for the model you want. Select the model and review the available spawn options. Use Spawn Ped or Spawn Animal . Choose one model at a time so you can check the result. To customize equipment on an active or owned horse, use Horse Outfits . An outfit file changes equipment; it is not a replacement for spawning or acquiring a horse. Change your own character model Open Self → Outfits → Model Changer and choose an available model. Save your current outfit first if you want a file to return to later. After changing models, open Outfits → Wardrobe and select Refresh Wardrobe . Clothing slots and compatible items depend on the selected model; wait for its scan to finish. If a model is missing or will not spawn Empty library: clear the search and switch from Favorites to the full category. Nothing appears: wait until your character is fully loaded, move to an open area, and try a standard model from the library. A downloaded model pack does not appear: these libraries do not install custom game assets. Follow that pack's RDR2-specific requirements and installation instructions. A GTA 5 or RedM download fails: get a version explicitly made for Scooby RDR2. A similar filename or extension does not make the content compatible.

title: Features Not Working
text: Features Not Working If Scooby loads but none of the features do anything , that almost always means one thing: CS2 HAS BEEN UPDATED AND SCOOBY NEEDS UPDATING TO MATCH Valve patches CS2 regularly, and every patch moves things around internally. Until Scooby is rebuilt against the new version, the menu will open but the features will not work. How long does an update take? It varies. Sometimes it is within an hour of the CS2 update, sometimes a day , sometimes up to about five days - realistically, whenever we have time to get to it. The CS2 menu is completely free , so it sits behind the paid products in the queue. We would rather be straight with you about that than promise a turnaround we cannot always hit. What to do in the meantime There is nothing to fix on your end - reinstalling will not help. Check the Discord for the current status, and update the loader once the new build is announced.

title: Antivirus & Download FAQ
text: Antivirus & Download FAQ The most common questions people ask before they even get the loader running. Read these first if Windows is blocking or removing your download. Why is Scooby flagged as a virus? It is most commonly known as a false positive , which means your PC may automatically flag the mod menu as malware because it doesn't recognise the file or its intentions. This happens due to the way mod menus are developed, not necessarily because they are malicious. How can I download the loader? Simply disable Real-time Protection in Windows Security. You may also need to temporarily disable your browser's Safe Browsing or Safe Search feature if it prevents the download. Recommended browsers are Chrome and Firefox . Why does the Scooby loader delete itself after some time? This usually happens because the loader hasn't been added as an exclusion in Windows Defender. When Real-time Protection is re-enabled, Windows Defender may automatically remove the loader. To prevent this, open Windows Security and go to: Virus & threat protection → Manage settings → Add or remove exclusions → Add an exclusion Select the Scooby loader. Once it has been added as an exclusion, Windows Defender should no longer remove it automatically.

title: Use Scooby on Linux & Mac
text: Use Scooby on Linux & Mac Compatibility preview. Game support is still being tested. What works and what to expect . 1. Get ready 2. Choose your setup 3. Start playing Get help 1. Get ready Download and extract Scooby. Get Scooby-compatibility.zip from Scooby downloads and extract the whole ZIP. Keep all the files together. If you only see the Windows installer, ask support for the compatibility preview . Check your game works first. Open the Windows version of your game through its usual launcher at least once. It needs to work on its own before you add Scooby. Open a terminal in the extracted folder. Open the folder containing linux , right-click an empty area and choose Open in Terminal , if your file manager offers it. New to the terminal? Start here A terminal lets you run the short commands in this guide. On Steam Deck, use Desktop Mode and open Konsole . Paste a command with Ctrl + Shift + V , then press Enter . Keep the terminal in the extracted folder that contains linux . If you opened it elsewhere, type cd followed by that folder's full path in quotes, then press Enter. Run Scooby as your normal user, without sudo . The launch scripts need Python 3.10 or newer . Check with this command: python3 --version A result such as Python 3.12.3 is fine. If Python is missing or older than 3.10, install it using your system's supported package manager. 2. Choose your setup Open the option that matches how you start your game. You only need to follow one. Linux with Steam I launch my game from my Steam library. Install Protontricks. Follow the official installation instructions . Installed it through Discover or as a Flatpak? Use the Steam Deck / Flatpak steps instead. Start your game once with Proton. In Steam, open the game's Properties → Compatibility , select the Proton version you use for the Windows game, then launch it. Find your game number. Run this command. Look for your game in the list; the number next to it is its App ID . protontricks -l Your game's App ID Paste the number next to your game. Your launch command will update below. Replace APPID in the command below with the number next to your game. Open Scooby. Copy the command below into your terminal and press Enter. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --appid APPID The Scooby sign-in window should open. Then continue to Start playing . Keep using your game's usual Steam entry. Adding Scooby as a separate non-Steam game can put it in the wrong Windows environment. Advanced: I use a custom Steam data folder Only use this if you changed the game's Steam compatdata location. Replace the path with the folder containing pfx , not pfx itself. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --appid APPID --compat-data "/path/to/compatdata/APPID" The App ID field fills in the game number. You still need to replace the example folder path. Steam Deck / Flatpak I use a Steam Deck, or installed Protontricks through Flatpak. Use Desktop Mode. On Steam Deck, open Discover , search for Protontricks and install it. Leave SteamOS in its normal read-only state. Start the Windows game once through Steam. Use its usual Proton version. Keep the extracted Scooby folder open in your terminal. Find your game's App ID. Run this command and find the number next to your game. flatpak run com.github.Matoking.protontricks -l Your game's App ID Paste the number next to your game. Your launch command will update below. Replace APPID in the command below with the number next to your game. Open Scooby. Copy this command into the terminal and press Enter. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --flatpak --appid APPID When the sign-in window appears, continue to Start playing . Use Desktop Mode with a mouse or trackpad for now. Game Mode, controller navigation and suspend/resume are not yet verified. My game is on an SD card or another drive Protontricks may need permission to access that Steam library. Follow its Flatpak access instructions . The Scooby launcher already grants access to its own bin folder for each run. Linux with Lutris / Wine I use Lutris, Rockstar Games Launcher or another Wine setup. Using Lutris? You can set up a shortcut. Scooby needs the same Windows folder and Wine version as your game. Open your game's configuration in Lutris. Note the Wine prefix and Wine version . The prefix is the folder containing the game's Windows files. Add a locally installed game. Name it Scooby, choose the Wine runner, and select linux/bin/ScoobyLoader.exe from your extracted package. Match the two settings. Use the exact same Wine prefix and Wine version as your game. Leave the bundled DLL files beside ScoobyLoader.exe . Save and launch Scooby. Once the sign-in window opens, continue to Start playing . I use Wine directly, without Lutris Replace both paths with your game's Wine executable and existing prefix folder. Keep the quotes around the paths. sh linux/launch.sh --runner wine --wine "/path/to/wine" --prefix "/path/to/game-prefix" The prefix is the folder containing drive_c . It must already be set up and support 64-bit Windows apps. The launcher does not create or repair it. Do not use plain Wine on a Steam Proton prefix. Mac I have a Mac-compatible Wine setup for my Windows game. Mac support is unverified . You need Python 3.10+ and a Mac-compatible Wine version that runs Windows x64 apps. On Apple silicon, that Wine distribution must also provide the required translation and graphics support. Confirm your Windows game works first. Find the Wine executable and prefix used by that game. Open Terminal in the extracted Scooby folder. Replace both example paths, then run: sh linux/mac/launch.command --wine "/absolute/path/to/wine" --prefix "/absolute/path/to/game-prefix" Continue to Start playing if the sign-in window opens. Using CrossOver? Follow its instructions to run Scooby in the same bottle as your game. This script does not configure CrossOver bottles automatically. Double-clicking the script without the paths above will not set it up. Proton is Linux-only. 3. Start playing Sign in to Scooby. Use your account or follow the free-key guide . Open your game as usual. Use the Steam or Lutris entry you set up above. Follow your game's loading steps. Open its Scooby guide to check when to load the menu. Timing and game support vary. Next time: use the same launch command or Lutris shortcut. Close both the game and Scooby before changing Wine or Proton versions. Something not working? Pick the problem you see. “File not found” or the launch script will not open Open the extracted folder that contains linux , then open a terminal there. Check that linux/bin/ScoobyLoader.exe exists. Extract the whole compatibility ZIP again if files are missing; the standard Windows installer does not include these scripts. “Python not found” or “Runner not found” Check python3 --version ; you need 3.10 or newer. For Steam, install Protontricks. If you installed it through Discover or Flatpak, follow the Flatpak steps . For Wine, check the Wine executable path. Scooby cannot find my game Run the Windows version of the game and check your App ID. In Lutris, Scooby and the game must share the exact same Wine prefix and Wine version . A native Linux game cannot load the Windows menu. If these match, the game may still be incompatible with this preview. The window is blank, or text is missing Keep all the runtime DLLs beside the loader and check that your game works with the selected runner. For missing Segoe UI text, add a licensed copy of segoeui.ttf to the same prefix's drive_c/windows/Fonts folder, then restart Scooby. A graphics error may need help with your Wine/Proton setup. I need to update Scooby or find my settings Close Scooby, then download and extract the latest compatibility package. Updates are manual; an old package can be blocked by a required minimum version. Your settings are inside the game's prefix at drive_c/scooby (the Windows path C:\scooby ). Each prefix has separate data. If changing prefixes causes an HWID mismatch, follow the HWID reset guide . The game is running slowly Compare the game with and without Scooby using the same settings. Performance depends on your graphics drivers, Wine/Proton version and enabled menu features. Close both apps before testing a different runner, and keep the game and loader on the same version. I need more help / want to check my setup Add --diagnose to the end of your launch command. It prints a setup report without opening Scooby. This checks local files and launch options; it does not prove that login, graphics, Steam/Flatpak access or game loading will work. Send Scooby support your OS, game, Wine/Proton version and exact error. Remove private details from reports and never share passwords or license keys. What works and what to expect This package runs the Windows x64 loader through Wine or Proton. Login, graphics and in-game loading still need testing on real Linux, Steam Deck and Mac systems. No game is certified yet; the loader opening does not guarantee that its menu will work. Windows-only cleaner, identifier and kernel-driver tools are unavailable. Native Linux/Mac games cannot load Windows DLLs. Game and anti-cheat restrictions still apply.

title: Universal Troubleshooting
text: Universal Troubleshooting Fixes for the specific errors people hit most often. This list is updated regularly - check back after an update before opening a ticket. Not injecting Make sure you have disabled BattlEye in the Rockstar Launcher. If you launch through Steam or Epic , disable it there too with the launch argument -nobattleye Exclude the Scooby application and its folder in Documents from Windows Defender. Third-party antivirus can still cause issues even when fully disabled Run Scooby as Administrator Delete the Scooby folder in your C:\ drive Remove OneDrive - it can cause permission issues in the Documents folder Verify your system files: open CMD as Administrator and run sfc /scannow Make sure your C: drive and Scooby folder have Full Control in their Properties → Security settings "Failed to inject module. Try disabling your Anti-Virus." A few different things cause this error. Follow these steps correctly and it should stop appearing: Make sure you are using the correct Windows user profile with Administrator privileges , and always run the Scooby loader as Administrator Move the Scooby loader to your Desktop , then add both the loader and your C: drive folder to your antivirus exclusions If you have OneDrive enabled, fully unlink and uninstall it You can tell OneDrive is getting in the way if you can't find the Scooby folder in your normal Documents folder , or if the path shown in your antivirus exclusions contains "OneDrive" . Crashing on inject Exclude the Scooby application and its folder in Documents from Windows Defender. Third-party antivirus can still cause issues even when fully disabled Check the log to see if you are getting Failed to Find Patterns - if so, follow the Failed to Find Patterns guide in our Discord Make sure HDR is disabled in Windows Display Settings Verify your GTA game files Delete the Scooby folder in your C:\ drive Verify your system files: open CMD as Administrator and run sfc /scannow Loader not opening, or "Auth Failed" error Use a VPN - https://one.one.one.one/ Disable or remove any third-party antivirus "GTA detected a fatal error" Most of the time this is not caused by Scooby , but by faulty game files or something else on your system. Look up the specific error code shown (for example ERR_GFX_STATE ) - it will point you to the actual cause. Subscribed scripts not showing up Use a VPN - https://one.one.one.one/ Why am I getting desync-kicked by BattlEye while using Scooby? With Premium and BattlEye disabled , you must remain the session host at all times . Joining or continuing a public session as a non-host can cause a desync after about 3–5 minutes . Premium lets you host public lobbies and play with friends, including players who have BattlEye enabled . The free version does not support public lobbies. To prevent it, start your own sessions as the host. You will then be able to play normally with non-modders who have BattlEye enabled. In the menu, go to: Session Tab → Session Starter → Invite-Only Session or New Public Session If you want other players to join, enable the Advertise Session function in the host toolkit, or simply invite your friends. See How To Host Public Sessions with Scooby for the full walkthrough. Premium Plus supports BattlEye enabled and lets you join public lobbies and play with friends as either the host or a non-host. You do not need to stay the session host. See the Free, Premium, and Premium Plus comparison for the tier requirements. Getting BattlEye kicked even without Scooby running You most likely joined a public lobby where you were not the host and got kicked by BattlEye while using Scooby. You will need to wait 12-24 hours for the kick to go away. Until then, stick to lobbies where you are the host , or where another BattlEye-disabled player is the host. Scooby folder not in Documents Check your C:\ drive for it. It falls back there if permissions fail in Documents - usually because of OneDrive.
